news.h: Williams connects with Loveland to set up Santos' winning field goal as Bears edge Buccaneers 27-24
news.d: — Caleb Williams found a wide-open Colston Loveland for a 38-yard catch to set up Cairo Santos' 38-yard field goal as time expired, and the Chicago Bears picked up a sloppy 27-24 victory over Baker Mayfield and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday night.

news.h: Bucs down Falcons without pass completion; Bucky Irving, Kenny Gainwell run wild
news.d: Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass, but the Buccaneers beat the Falcons 16-0 behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.

news.h: Buccaneers beat Falcons 16-0 despite failing to complete a single pass in wet, sloppy conditions
news.d: — Baker Mayfield threw more downfield blocks than he had completions.

news.h: Baker Mayfield needs to attempt only 11 passes in Buccaneers' blowout win
news.d: Baker Mayfield needed to attempt only 11 passes in the Buccaneers' 43-13 victory against the Carolina Panthers on Sunday.
